newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Mar palm oil output seen up 25 pct-Wong.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Mar palm oil output seen up 25 pct-Wong.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in March is expected to have risen by 25 percent to 630,000 tonnes from February, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Friday.
Wong put palm oil stocks for end-March at 710,000 tonnes, compared to the actual volume of 722,993 tonnes noted by the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) at end-January.
Exports were estimated at 545,000 tonnes against February's 376,885 tonnes.
Wong said in a report that he has to scaled down the size of the the March crop to adjust for the lack of harvesr brought forwards.
He added that the much larger than expected stocks in February reflected entirely poorer then estimated offtake, especially domestic disappearance.
"With production registering positive grwoth but exports trailing year ago levels, the outcome can only be higher stocks," Wong said.
